tool.name: Simulate the result of a high-throughput docking protocol
tool.description: using the rbhtfinder provided with rxDock

param.name: thr1max
param.label: Maximum for the range of thresholds to simulate

param.name: thr1min
param.label: Minimum for the range of thresholds to simulate

tool.help:
.. class:: infomark
The rbhtfinder program is part of the rDock suite, and helps users to find suitable thresholds for docking, in order to strike a balance between generating an adequate number of poses and minimal compute time.
rDock allows specifying required thresholds for docking scores and pharmacophoric restraints; if these thresholds are not met after a specified number of poses, the compound will be discarded. Rbhtfinder allows specifying two points at which thresholds will be applied, the "Number of poses in stage 1 and 2" parameters. It will generate a list of possible threshold values for all values between the "Maximum" and "Minimum" parameters, and predict the time and number of poses rDock would return based on those values.
See https://rdock.sourceforge.net/ for more details about rDock and associated programs. A specific tutorial for docking with rbhtfinder is provided at https://rdock.sourceforge.net/multistep-protocol-for-htvs/.
-----
.. class:: infomark
**Inputs** A tabular file produced using sdreport, generated from an SD-file produced by an initial docking run in which a small subset of the compounds are docked exhaustively (e.g. 100 poses). The results of this initial run will be used to generate the predicted times and percentages if various thresholds were to be applied.
-----
.. class:: infomark
**Outputs** A text file listing molecules from the SD-file and the values for the specified fields.
``` TIME PERC1 PERC2 N1 THR1 N2 THR2 7.252, 23.036, 3.283, 5, -10, 15, -15 *** 7.393, 23.050, 1.995, 5, -10, 15, -16 *** 7.482, 23.074, 1.176, 5, -10, 15, -17 *** 6.552, 15.391, 1.888, 5, -11, 15, -16 *** 6.633, 15.385, 1.121, 5, -11, 15, -17 *** 6.681, 15.375, 0.650, 5, -11, 15, -18 6.023, 9.893, 1.055, 5, -12, 15, -17 *** 6.071, 9.915, 0.621, 5, -12, 15, -18 6.094, 9.886, 0.360, 5, -12, 15, -19 5.637, 6.045, 0.571, 5, -13, 15, -18 5.663, 6.058, 0.339, 5, -13, 15, -19 5.676, 6.051, 0.193, 5, -13, 15, -20 5.388, 3.629, 0.316, 5, -14, 15, -19 5.400, 3.612, 0.177, 5, -14, 15, -20 5.410, 3.627, 0.090, 5, -14, 15, -21 5.228, 2.101, 0.162, 5, -15, 15, -20 5.234, 2.087, 0.081, 5, -15, 15, -21 5.239, 2.091, 0.036, 5, -15, 15, -22 ```
Each row represents a hypothetical docking run with a particular combination of threshold parameters. Values for each combination of thresholds are given by THR1 and THR2; these values are generated between the minimum and maximum parameters specified by the tool. N1 and N2 are the number of poses which would generated before THR1 and THR2 respectively are applied, and PERC1 ad PERC2 are the percentages of poses predicted to be retained after each of the thresholds. TIME represents the relative amount of compute time consumed; in general, the stricter the thresholds, the more poses are discarded and the lower the compute time. Threshold combinations which are recommended by rbhtfinder are marked with three asterisks (***); these should provide a balance between number of poses generated and compute time.
